fullContentHtml:
SSC CGL Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the Admit Card for the post of Combined Graduate Level CGL Examination 2026. This recruitment was released for 12256 posts. Applications for the SSC CGL Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 21 May 2026, to 25 August 2026. The written examination is going to be conducted on 30 September 2026 – 30 October 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their SSC CGL Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 21 May 2026
  • Last Date : 25 June 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 26 June 2026
  • Correction Date : 01-03 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 30 September 2026 – 30 October 2026
  • Exam City Details : 22 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 27 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-
  • All Category Female : 0/-
  • Correction Charges :
  • First Time : Rs. 200/-
  • Second Time : Rs. 500/-

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Click on the official Admit Card link given below.
  2. Login using your Application Number / Roll Number and Password / DOB.
  3. Your Admit Card will be displayed on screen.
  4. Download the PDF and take a clear printout to carry to the exam venue.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is SSC CGL Admit Card 2026?

SSC CGL Admit Card 2026 is the official hall ticket for the upcoming examination. Candidates must carry it along with a valid photo ID to the exam centre.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
